isaac.text:
For those of you already in the demons dynasty NFL fantasy weekly recaps will be nothing new. And for NBA fantasy there’s nothing different here. I’ll be doing some brief recaps every week so people stay interested alongside awarding my biggest chud, shit vs poo award and my holy glaze of the week.

Kyran v Isaac
Our highest scoring matchup of the week was won by an essentially perfect set of picks by Kyran alongside some exceptional performances such as jokic dropping 53 and Naz Reid (???) dropping 31 on his first game of the season. This combined with some managerial mistakes on my end and a jalen williams stinker handed Kyran the win.

Tony v Jack
Our biggest blowout of the week was defined by huge performances across Jill’s horrible team. With 4 players getting over 30 points and 2 of those 4 getting over 40 it was never in doubt for Jack. In fact it was such a walk over that Jack won every single head to head player matchup apart from 1 in this game.

Lewis v Matt
In what seems like the unluckiest loss of the week Lewis takes down Matt in a high scoring affair. On Matt’s side I’d say that the main reason for loss was unfortunate performances from Ausar Thompson, Rudy Gobert and Mikel Bridges. Had those guys lived up to their predicteds this would have been a closer game. This alongside an exceptional managerial performance by Lewis led to the win.

Maxi vs David
In the weekly battle of shit vs poo maxi edges out a win against David. David saw that ant dropped 44 in his first game and just refused to lock it in. Saw PG dropped 37 and again refused to lock it in. Actually looking at it I don’t think David locked a single player in this week and just let their last games determine  their score. The only reason this was close was due to Maxi locking in a 0 from curry and starting Alex Sarr.

That wraps up the week one match ups and without further ado the winners for each award are.

Biggest Chud: David
Shit vs Poo award: Maxi vs David
Holy glaze of the week: Kyran

claude.text: Lewis posted the week's top score (270.5) and beat Matt by 57.5. Jack's 85-point win over Tony is still the biggest margin of the season. Kyran counted the player's best game of the week in 8 of 9 slots to edge Isaac by 5; Isaac's 260.5 would have beaten four other teams. David let 7 of 9 slots run to the final game: Edwards' 45 became a 14 and Paul George's 37.5 became a 21. Maxi still won with 216.5 despite a 0 from Curry.

isaac.text:
Well well well we’re here again for another week of NBA in tah and with that comes of course last weeks recaps. An overwhelmingly poo week in terms of points averages in relation to last week but we move. Two new designations will be added in my recaps this week, Heaven and Hell. Heaven is reserved for someone who I think is undeservedly underperforming and needs a bit of Lady Luck on his side. Hell is for the opposite, someone who’s had a bit too much luck to get them to where they’re at.

Isaac v David
In one of our biggest blowouts of the week David got absolutely spanked by yours truly. This is largely due to David still not having a proper grasp on the practical use of the lock in mechanics as 5 out of 9 players were locked in below their highest point totals of the week. Of course we must mourn the loss of Anthony Edwards for David who will be without his star guard for at least 1 month. New gen splash brothers didn’t last long. Also it must be noted that this game was won with the highest score achieved so far on NBA fantasy as I got a whopping 271 points.

Kyran v Tony
In a battle of poo for the ages we see the two K-town massives go head to head in a match up almost reminiscent of the western colonisation of the Asian sub continent. And much like those wars this game followed a similar trodden path as white colonised slightly less white. Kyran edged out a win despite some less than optimal managerial decisions. Some good 30 point plus performances across the team gave him the win here. Tony, why are we locking in a 16.5 bomb my Trae Young and why are we settling for a fat 17.5 from Evan Mobley. This truly was a managerial choke job akin to Hitlers Eastern Front campaign

Lewis v Maxi
Now as of writing this this game hasn’t concluded quite yet however unless Julius randle drops 45 against the pacers tonight. Despite a whopping 51 point performance from Wemby Lewises guards and small forward let him down this week. OG Anunoby (or as he pronounces it “oguh anoonabie) was the real disappointment looking like a lost baby on the court this week. This isn’t to detract from a good performance from maxi led by some 40+ performances from cooper Flagg, Steph Curry and Brandon Miller. However, in a very strange turn of events Maxi locked in a -0.5 performance from Yaxel Lendebourg despite him having still to play a game this week(??). Strange way to flex on your opponent but okay.

Jack Hill v Matt
This is unfortunately a big blowout in jacks favour as he commanded his team to a comprehensive win and a good managerial performance. Trust me it hurts for me to say this but he did a good job. Picking up Acoff actually did turn out to be a good decision and the lock ins were pretty much on point. Unlucky from Matt and honestly not much to say about this one. Very unlucky for Matt with Kawhi Leonard and Jaren Jackson Jr going down with injuries.

And now for the awards
Biggest Chud: Tonysan
Shit vs Poo award: Kyransan v Tonysan
Holy Glaze of the Week: Me
Heaven: Gonzalez
Hell: GPT

claude.text: Isaac's 271 was the week's best (Şengün 41, Boozer 38.5). Maxi beat Lewis 246–224.5 behind Flagg 45.5 and Curry 42, so Wemby's 51 wasn't enough, and that was with a −0.5 troll lock. Tony's LaVine slot finished on 4.5 after a 25 earlier in the week, and his 181 was the week's low. Jack beat Matt by 55 with Porter 33.5 and Giannis 43. Matt was Sleeper's most efficient manager (89.3% of max) and still lost.

isaac.text:
Right guys we’re back with the third NBA in Tah weekly recap. A week of records broken and forgetful picks has thrust us into a situation in which the two remaining undefeated teams are the highest overall points scorer and strangely the fifth highest point scorer, some may argue schedules been a bit of a help here. Anyways, on to the weekly recap and of course the all hallowed, shrouded in gold, weekly awards.

Isaac v Lewis
To kick things off we have one of the highest scoring games of the season so far as Lewis and I put up a combined 539 points between us with only a 14 point difference between the teams. Lewis edged the victory obviously with a stormer of a performance from Wemby as he dropped the second highest fantasy NBA point score of all time, just behind Hakeem Olajuwon in 1987. Wemby had a truly napoleonic performance as he raped and ravaged the Mavericks with 52 points and 24 rebounds among some other ridiculous statlines. Whilst I put up a good performance it just wasn’t enough to stop the alien invasion, I could have won if I did the right picks but of course key word there is “if”.

Kyran v Jack
This is actually our highest ever scoring NBA in Tah game as both sides beat the previous record for highest points in a week. In a 553 point neck and neck race the winner was unfortunately Jack despite him being in commissioner designated hell all week. This was essentially just good picks and good games all round for both of these guys as Kyrans lowest scoring player was Derrick White dropping 22 against the bucks and Jacks being MPJ who dropped 25 on charlotte. This just goes to show that you don’t just need individual outstanding performances to win in this league but rather a whole team of consistent dubs. I think this may be the Strat going forwards. Alas Jack secures yet another win and Kyran loses the 0 in his loss column. A top table battle for the ages.

Tony v David
In our battle of poo for the week we saw the two lowest scoring teams in the league go head to head in an absolutely shocking game week. The trend of Tony only locking in players if they’re going to have a better game in their next one continues in a way as he locked in Trey Murphy on an 18.5 the night he dropped 24 on the clippers. Although I will give to him that he locked in cade right before he had a stinker. David just managed to get over the line on this one but Tony would have been able to put up an actual good performance had he realised that the game week was actually going on. All in all too David had some pretty wank performances from some of his players but I guess it doesn’t matter if the guy you’re playing forgets to lock people in.

Matt v Maxi
This is the closest matchup we’ve seen as just 2.5 points separated Matt and Maxi. I think this is the type of game where it’s just all down to either luck or injuries. Whoever has the less injured team or whoever gets the luckiest ends up winning and thats just a shame for those like Matt who have been on the wrong end of Lady Lucks stick so far this season. Both teams had clean games and ended up scoring a pretty bang average week. Of course this has left Maxi as one of the two only undefeated teams left and left Matt as one of only two winless teams despite Matt only having scored 50 less points than Maxi on the season. Despite being in heaven for this week Matt remains the statistically most scored against player in the league and the worst part of that is that there is absolutely nothing he can do it about it. A good win by Maxi but ultimately the biggest toss up of the league so far this week.

And now for the all important awards section. We have our first two time winners for a few categories here so buckle up
Biggest Chud: Tonysan (for the second week running)
Shit vs Poo Award: Tony v David (both have already won this award)
Holy Glaze of the week: Jack (279 points is too high to ignore)
Heaven: Matt Gonzalez
Hell: Lewis (fuck wemby)

That wraps up the weekly recap, don’t forget to set your lineups for this week and lock in the good pefrformances not the bad ones… Tony
